name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension of Singleton–Cosingleton Classes
proof: The nonempty intersection closure is exactly $I(\mathcal A_n)=2^{[n]}\setminus\{[n]\}$. Indeed every proper $T\subsetneq[n]$ is the nonempty intersection $\bigcap_{i\notin T}([n]\setminus\{i\})$, and no intersection of proper supports can equal $[n]$. This closure has VC $n-1$. Survey Proposition \ref{prop:intersection-closure-positive-teaching} identifies its VC with $\mathrm{RTD}^{+p}(\mathcal A_n)$, proving the stated value.
references: Local definition-driven proof and exact finite replay in sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py. The class was already used in the survey's signed intersection-completion argument.
